findings: At this source revision, git grep finds no caller of KvTierSession::report in src/ or include/: the only occurrences are its declaration and definition. The harness therefore cannot lawfully pass a cold arm without an engine instrumentation change; it will report missing counters as a failure rather than infer cold reads from output identity or file activity.
The engine's STRATA_LOGPOS teacher-forced NLL surface is in serve mode, not one-shot generate mode. The harness drives the GEN protocol and T/DONE lines accordingly.
implementation: scripts/b550_acceptance.py implements read-only identity, CUDA sm86 build/device identity, STRATA_SM86_PERF off/on NLL identity, matched cold off/on control, counter and graph-proof refusal rules, and selected 600K/800K scale controls.

The live-model driver uses the engine serve protocol because that is where STRATA_LOGPOS and the KV serving hooks execute. It parses contiguous absolute scored positions and the DONE timing/count fields.
The SSH execution path uses argv lists and quoted remote commands; it checks compute apps before each arm and contains no kill, restart, service, PID, or storage teardown operation.
A cold arm requires exactly one tier report with nonzero l2_reads and l1_evictions, zero read failures/checksum errors/graph violations, and at least one complete graph window.
non_claims: No B550 hostname, GPU model, compute capability, CUDA build, device selftest, model run, token ID, NLL, tier counter, eviction, or scale result was observed.
No Optane model, serial, partition, mount state, or SMART state was observed.
The unreachable-host result is not a hardware-health diagnosis and the absent host is not treated as a pass.
The local script tests and quality gate do not compile CUDA on B550, exercise a real model, move a KV byte, or validate remote performance.
The unit-test fake serve engine proves parsing and decision behavior only; it is not a hardware result.

The engine-host restore counter was added to the required-counter set and to the cold-control refusal, so a cold arm that publishes bytes but never reaches the copy the attention reads fails the gate.
The tier report is now printed by the engine at session shutdown, which is what the harness parses; without that call site the harness could never lawfully pass a cold arm.
